verdict.rationale: Privacy posture, including opting out of usage tracking, is a fair question for an email-marketing SaaS. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The cited items cover API features, the email builder, analytics on recipients, and contact export, none of which address the user's own tracking controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
